title: Micro Onboarding Sprint Playbook — First 7 Days
body:
Purpose:
A compact, operational-first checklist and daily agenda designed to turn a new hire into a productive member of the team within seven days. This is intentionally pragmatic — pick concrete signals of progress (accounts, small PR, first customer shadow) rather than abstract goals.

Quick summary (one-line):
- Day 0-1 access + environment ready. Day 2-3 tooling + tiny ship. Day 4-5 domain context + customer shadow. Day 6-7 independent micro-deliverable + sync.

Success signals (FirstWeek:Ready badge criteria):
- Auth + SSO + email + Slack working
- Dev machine provisioned or cloud workspace validated
- One repo cloned, build completes, test suite runs locally (or CI passes)
- One small PR merged (docs bug, README fix, or tiny test)
- 1:1 with manager + clear 30/60/90 draft
- Buddy assigned and 3 quick syncs completed
- Customer or infra shadow session attended

Day-by-day playbook:
Day 0 (pre-boarding, People Ops):
- Send welcome slack + calendar invites (IT, buddy, hiring manager)
- Provision accounts: Okta, GitHub, Jira, Confluence, GCP/AWS access request opened
- Workspace checklist sent (keys, VPN, hardware)
- "Notes to self": confirm backup access path if KMS approvals delayed

Day 1 (orientation + access verification):
- 9:00 AM: Quick team welcome (15m) — intro, org chart paper sketch
- 10:00 AM: IT/Access walkthrough; confirm Slack/Okta/GitHub
- 2:00 PM: Security quick read (15m) + acknowledgment checkbox
- Deliverable: reply with screenshot of successful repo clone + CI run link

Day 2 (tools + first tasks):
- Paired session with buddy: run local dev loop or cloud sandbox
- Assign first micro-task (label: first-week): small docs fix, lint rule, or infra sanity check
- Schedule "shadow" (customer call or infra runbook) for Day 4 or 5

Day 3 (context + community):
- 30m: Product walkthrough with PM (build/usage, current roadmaps)
- 30m: Architecture map with eng lead (high level, key services)
- Deliverable: short 1-paragraph "what I think we ship" written in Confluence

Day 4 (deep dive + shadow):
- Attend customer call or SRE incident postmortem (observe)
- 1:1 with manager to align 30/60/90, confirm early deliverable
- Deliverable: merge a non-prod PR or update runbook

Day 5 (ownership + small win):
- Lead a 15m sync: propose a 2-week spike or docs improvement
- Close out the first micro-project; ensure tests/CI pass
- Fill FirstWeek:Ready short form in Confluence

Day 6 (polish + knowledge capture):
- Create a personal "day-1-to-7" note for future hires (what tripped me)
- Pair with buddy to document two troubleshooting steps learned

Day 7 (review + next steps):
- Demo small deliverable to team (5–7m)
- 30m feedback session (manager + buddy) with concrete next tasks
- Archive checklist as complete and confirm follow-ups (training, security course)

Role-specific micro-project ideas (pick one):
- Engineer: fix a flaky test, add a README section, or add an E2E smoke test
- Product: draft a one-pager for a micro-feature and run discovery interview with 1 stakeholder
- People Ops: complete a benefits enrollment audit for a small cohort and propose one FAQ

Access and escalation matrix (practical):
- If Okta fails: raise IT ticket + DM People Ops lead + request temporary alt account
- If repo build fails: pair with buddy, open Jira ticket with logs, add "first-week" label
- If KMS or prod data access blocked: do a read-only walk-through with SRE; never request bulk credentials first week

Templates and snippets (copy/paste):
- Welcome DM to send to new hire: "Welcome [Name]! We’ve set up your Slack, Okta, and GitHub. Your buddy is [Buddy]. First 30m: intro at 10:00. Ping me if anything blocked."
- PR checklist (first-week): includes description, small scope, test steps, and reviewer assigned by buddy

Measurement: quick scoreboard to capture on Day 7 (yes/no):
- Accounts OK
- Repo build OK
- PR merged
- 1:1 done
- Shadow attended
- FirstWeek:Ready form submitted

Open questions / outstanding items (notes to people-ops):
- Should we automate the FirstWeek:Ready badge via GitHub actions (auto check CI + PR merged)?
- Can we create a default "first-week" label with auto-assigned reviewer (buddy) in repos?

Links and artifacts (operational):
- New hire checklist (canonical): https://confluence.redwood.ai/onboard/canonical-checklist
- Access request form: https://forms.redwood.ai/access-request
- FirstWeek:Ready short form: https://confluence.redwood.ai/onboard/firstweek-form

Small, iterative improvements suggested after every hire:
- Reduce the time to first PR by creating two curated "first-week" issues in each team repo
- Buddy rotation: rotate after every 4 hires to avoid burnout
- Keep the shadow slot on Tuesdays and Thursdays (core meeting days)

Footer: this doc is intentionally lightweight and meant to be copied into team folders and adapted. Mark as 'in_review' until we automate the badge and standardize repo labels.
